### Libraries

```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
```

### Data

```{r}
# Data Import from GitHub
cars <- read_csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/djara300/Project_1_4740/main/pakistan_cars.csv"
  )

head(cars, n=5)
```

### Exploratory Data

#### Summary Tables

```{r}
# Number of Brands, Types of Fuel, & Cities in Dataset
cars |> 
  summarise(Num_Brands = length(unique(brand)), 
            Num_Models = length(unique(model)),
            Num_Fuel_Type = length(unique(fuel_type)), 
            Num_Cities = length(unique(city))) |> 
  kable()


# Numnber of cars per Brand
cars |> 
  group_by(brand) |> 
  summarise("Number of Cars" = length(brand)) |> 
  rename("Brand" = brand) |>
  arrange(desc(`Number of Cars`)) |> 
  head(10) |> 
  kable()


# Number of cars per Type of Fuel 
cars |> 
  group_by(fuel_type) |> 
  summarise("Number of Cars" = length(fuel_type)) |> 
  rename("Fuel Type" = fuel_type) |> 
  arrange(desc(`Number of Cars`)) |> 
  kable()


# Number of cars listed in each City 
cars |> 
  group_by(city) |> 
  summarise("Number of Cars" = length(city)) |> 
  rename("City" = city) |>
  arrange(desc(`Number of Cars`)) |> 
  head(10) |> 
  kable()
```
